name: Trilium Notes System & Template Studio
description: Component-driven, editable, and organizable notes system layer for Trilium Notes with Today Homepage, Template Studio, and If/Then Automation Rules.
author: Ian Sherr

settings.title: Journal Split Width (%)
settings.description: Default width percentage allocated to the Journal side panel on the Today Homepage.

settings.title: Execute If/Then Rules on Note Creation
settings.description: Automatically evaluate if/then automation rules when new notes are created.

settings.title: Enable Derived Topic Propagation
settings.description: Automatically calculate and assign derived topics from parent project, client, or organization relations.

settings.title: File New Notes Under Today's Journal Note
settings.description: Add a reference link for newly created tasks, meetings, and story drafts to the current day note.

settings.title: Default Quick Capture Template
settings.description: Template ID triggered by default when clicking the global header Quick Capture button.

settings.title: Stale Notes Inactivity Threshold (Days)
settings.description: Number of inactive days before active notes appear in the Stale Notes review list.

settings.title: Daily Writing Goal (Words)
settings.description: Target daily word count for the Writing Goal progress bar and activity heatmaps.
